target_customer: Indonesian employers (hiring teams, later HR departments) who pay for curated candidates and an ATS, plus young Indonesian job seekers who use it free
problem: Indonesian employers struggle to find pre-screened candidates among large volumes of unqualified applicants, and young job seekers lack guidance and fast responses.
business_model: B2B recruiting SaaS and job portal (employer vacancy and ATS fees) with free job seeker mentoring; later HRIS (KantorKu)
product_category: Job portal, ATS and career mentoring in Indonesia

founders.name: Andhika Sudarman
education: Attended Harvard Law School (per YC page)
previous_startups: SejutaCita (community for local and international graduates; YC page claims over $300K annual revenue and profitability)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no prior employers. SejutaCita is the legal entity name of Dealls per press coverage.

competitors.name: Glints
competitors.what: Southeast Asian job and career platform aimed at young professionals, with mentorship content

competitors.name: Kalibrr
competitors.what: Matching-focused job platform with resume and interview tools

competitors.name: JobStreet
competitors.what: Long-established job portal across Southeast Asia including Indonesia

technical_complexity.rationale: A job portal with applicant tracking and curation is standard web engineering; the hard part is operations and candidate screening, not technology.

defensibility.rationale: Job portals are easy to copy. Defensibility rests on employer relationships and the candidate pool built through free mentoring, with no data or regulatory moat found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquisition found; Dealls kept growing and expanded into B2B HR software (KantorKu HRIS) per its own blog, with LinkedIn naming it a top Indonesian startup in September 2024.

market_need_then: Indonesia has a large young population entering the workforce and many employers reporting difficulty filtering applicants; the YC page claims 5,000+ employers and responses 21x faster, which are company claims.

branding.domain_note: Uses dealls.com (exact .com with doubled l); no acquisition history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Indonesian-language career content blog with promotional rankings of job portals

branding.community_and_virality: App branded Dealls: Jobs & Mentoring; the group markets a free mentoring program and CV reviewer; Andhika Sudarman did a public mentoring event with the education minister (Investor.id, Nov 2022 per YC page). No fan community evidence opened.

brand_strength.rationale: Local brand with some press and an award claim on the YC page, but no sourced evidence of strong consumer brand pull; the spelling resembles Dell or deals.

outcome_analysis: Dealls appears to have grown steadily in Indonesia, reaching a team of about 127 per the YC page and expanding into HR software with KantorKu HRIS. No layoffs, acquisition or shutdown were found. Its growth seems tied to a free mentoring program that feeds a candidate pool and a large young Indonesian market, but funding is not verified by any primary source.
notes: Funding unverified: CB Insights and Caplight (aggregators) show about $500K total, a convertible note or accelerator deal dated Jan or Mar 2022; they disagree on date and label, so no round is recorded. Competitor entries come from undated directory and company pages, not sources dated near the batch. Founded year 2020 per YC page; one profile says 2022.
